//: Issue #4/#7/#25 (GPT 1) — extra checks over the shared tsconfig.json, which is owned by issue #2 (GPT 2). Kept in a separate file so the shared one stays byte-identical across branches and never conflicts on merge. `erasableSyntaxOnly` is the important one: Node runs these packages by stripping types, so any TypeScript that cannot simply be erased (a parameter property, an enum) would fail at run time rather than at build time.
